correctness.rationale: The proof uses the published complete edge criterion for S-hypersimplices specialized to a consecutive interval. Three explicit route constructions give the upper bound. The minimum of their length functions is proved one-Lipschitz on every permitted edge, including separate bottom- and top-swap checks, which gives the matching lower bound. Complement symmetry and explicit extremal pairs then give the exact diameter. The packaged breadth-first-search checker agrees for every interval in dimensions 2 through 8.

value.rationale: The one-skeleton is a basic combinatorial invariant of S-hypersimplices and underlies navigation by edge moves. The result gives a closed all-pairs metric, identifies two precise boundary shortcuts to Hamming motion, and yields a sharp diameter for every consecutive-cardinality slab. This is a structural theorem for an infinite natural family rather than a recomputation of isolated small cases.
